googleImagesAccess: Attempted; inaccessible through available web tool. Fallback image-query descriptions reviewed for maple clipart and maple leaf/syrup/seed use cases.
method: Original compositions based on observed broad search intent: recognizable pointed maple leaves, botanical arrangements, seed growth and a smaller maple-syrup subset. Primary university extension and state forestry sources inform leaf/seed structures and sugaring season. No source pixels reused.
designDecisions: Most designs retain the maple leaf/branch/seed as the main subject, mixed with full trees, natural materials, frames, eight sugaring/food compositions, one reading character and six independent coloring outlines.
Paired samaras and opposite leaf attachment are explicit. No false scientific species certainty, no copied flag emblem and no third-party licensing promises.

Sap bucket and sugar shack scenes use leafless trees and late-winter patches of snow; no autumn sap-harvest imagery. Full framing and useful classroom/personal design compositions reviewed before export.
